data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, a woman named Razeenah is also seen as a source of happiness and joy for those around her. The name Razeenah is derived from the Arabic root "r-z-n," which means "to delight," "to please," or "to be pleased with." As such, a woman named Razeenah is believed to have a positive and uplifting presence that brings joy and happiness to all those who encounter her.
